note: {single-polarity: positive} carried on the row. Forbidden: a BGP-LS MP_REACH_NLRI whose next hop departs from the RFC 4760 layout. TestRFC7752BGPLSNextHopFollowsRFC4760 fails unless, for AFI 16388 SAFI 71, the encoder emits AFI, SAFI, next-hop length 4 or 16, the address, a zero reserved octet and then the NLRI, and the parse round-trips; IPv4 and IPv6 next hops both asserted.
